scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Those filthy little
creatures! Scurrying
around, snatching things
from me! If only they
weren't so blamed quick...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
那些脏兮兮的小东西！
到处乱窜，抢走我的东西！
要是它们没那么快就好了...

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, is that the
Sweet Rice my son made?
Would you let me have it?
Please wait here a moment,
and I'll make you some pastry~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，那是我儿子做的糯米吗？
能给我尝尝吗？
请稍等片刻，
我给您做点糕点~

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, where are all the
Rice Pouches? We need
them to make more rice cakes...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哎呀，我的米袋都去哪儿了？
没有它们就没法做米糕了...

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Ooh, those white and
blue mouses might have
snatched my Rice Pouches
Those moles probably took
them too. Such nasty little
creatures, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，那些蓝白相间的老鼠
可能偷走了我的米袋。
那些鼹鼠大概也拿了一些。
真是讨厌的小家伙，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, is that one of my
Rice Pouches? I'm sorry,
but the pain my hips..
Would you mind being
a dear, and delivering
that to my son for me?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，那是我的米袋吗？
抱歉，我的腰疼得厉害...
能麻烦您帮我把这个
交给我的儿子吗？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
It's not nearly enough
to repay you for what you've
done for me, but I'd like
you to have this pastry that
I just made. Please enjoy it~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
这点东西根本不足以报答
您对我的帮助，
但我想把这个刚做好的糕点
送给您。请享用~

scripts.text: [Rice Mill Grandma]
scripts.translation: [碾米坊婆婆]

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, I was just making
some rice cakes and
pastries to celebrate
the new year, but these
animals have been stealing
the Rice Pouches I've prepared.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，我本来正在做米糕和糕点
准备庆祝新年，
但这些动物一直偷走
我准备好的米袋。

scripts.text: Rice Pouches?
scripts.translation: 米袋？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Yes, my son needs those
Rice Pouches to pound the
rice in a mortar, but I can't
make any pastries if I don't
even have the rice. Do you
think you can help me?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
是的，我儿子需要用那些米袋
在石臼里捣米，
但如果没有米，我就做不了糕点。
您觉得能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 当然可以。

scripts.text: I don't even know you.
scripts.translation: 我甚至都不认识你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course.
What can I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然可以。
我能做什么？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Well, do you think you
can catch the animals that
stole my Rice Pouches?
They're these blue and
white rats and these
nasty little moles.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
嗯，您觉得能抓住
偷走我米袋的动物吗？
它们是那些蓝白相间的老鼠
和那些讨厌的小鼹鼠。

scripts.text: Not a problem.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not a problem.
I'll catch those animals,
and bring back any Rice
Pouches that I can find.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没问题。
我会抓住那些动物，
并找回我能找到的米袋。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Oh, thank you!
Good luck catching
those pests for me~
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
哦，谢谢您！
祝您抓到那些害虫顺利~

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
I... Well...
That's true, but I was
planning on giving you
something nice in return
for your help. I know you're
not a bad person, so...
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
我...嗯...
确实如此，但我原本打算
给您一些好东西作为回报。
我知道您不是坏人，所以...

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Grandma]
Thank you for the
Sweet Rice! I'll be
sure to make something
delicious for you if you
bring me more, okay?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊婆婆]
谢谢您带来的糯米！
如果您再给我带一些，
我一定给您做点好吃的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Breaks my heart...
My mom spends all this
time preparing rice for
the new year, and it's all
stolen by rats and vermin!
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
真是让人心痛...
我妈妈花了那么多时间准备过年的米，
结果全被老鼠和害虫偷走了！

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
I hear from my mother
that you're helping her out.
She's a sweet old lady, huh?
If you find ang Rice Pouches,
you might want to have her
inspect them first.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
听我妈妈说，您正在帮她。
她真是位和蔼的老奶奶，对吧？
如果您找到了米袋，
最好先让她检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
If you bring me some
Rice Pouches, then I can
pound into into Sweet Rice.
You're here to help out my
mother, right? Thanks,
I really appreciate that.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
如果您能给我一些米袋，
我就能把它们碾成糯米。
您是来帮妈妈的忙，对吧？
谢谢，我真的非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Oh, you brought me some
Rice Pouches from my mother?
Give me a second, and I'll
get this rice pounded into
paste, lickety split.
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
哦，您给我带了一些妈妈的米袋？
请稍等，我马上把这些米碾成米浆。

scripts.text: [Rice Mill Man]
scripts.translation: [碾米坊的男子]

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
Hoo! Haa! Hi-yah!
Woosha! Whoosha!
Ka-taaaaaaaaaa!
WOOOSHA!
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
呼！哈！嘿呀！
唰！唰！
咔哒————！
唰————！

scripts.text:
[Rice Mill Man]
All done. Here, this
Sweet Rice is ready to
be made into pastries
Would you please bring
this to my mother?
scripts.translation:
[碾米坊的男子]
全部完成了。给您，
这些糯米已经可以做成糕点啦。
麻烦您把这个带给我妈妈好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, I'm sorry, but we
can't do any business if
you're carry so much stuff.
Would you mind storing some of
your things with the Kafra Service?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
哎呀，不好意思，
您身上带了这么多东西，
没法做生意呢。
介意把一些东西存到卡普拉服务吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I want to earn enough
money to buy that big
crescent silver pin.
I have to sell as much
of this Mojji as I can!
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我想赚够钱，
买那枚大大的新月形银别针。
我必须把这些米糕都卖出去才行！

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, hello! I'm selling
special rice cakes made
from sweet rice. You can
eat it yourself, or feed it
to your New Year Doll if
you have one as a pet.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
哦，你好！
我在卖用糯米做的特别米糕。
您可以自己吃，
或者如果您有新年娃娃作为宠物，
也可以喂给它吃。

scripts.text: [Lunar]
scripts.translation: [露娜]

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Anyway, I'm selling
10 Mojji for 3,000 zeny
Would you like to try some?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
总之，我卖10个米糕，
价格是3,000 Zeny。
您想尝尝看吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Thank you, and I hope you
have a happy new year!
Please come again~
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
谢谢，祝您新年快乐！
欢迎下次再来~

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny right now....
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
哎呀，不好意思，
您现在的Zeny不够呢....

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Oh, alright. Well, I'll
be here if you or your
friends want some Mojji
later, alight? Goodbye~
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
哦，好的。那如果您或您的朋友
之后想要米糕的话，
我会一直在这里的，好吗？再见~
